title: the saved file differs from the draft in the one status scalar: comments, quotes, spacing, a trailing comment, blank lines and the word draft elsewhere stay byte for byte
source: intended: docs/decisions.md, "Only launches are blocked, and launches into other repositories": build save writes with no owner gate; --yes is accepted and changes nothing
intent: INTENDED behavior (defect N-15, drafts; docs/decisions.md "The v0.1.0 cut"). The written content is the draft bytes with the status value `draft` replaced by `approved`: the position is taken from the YAML node, so a trailing comment on the status line, a single or double quoted value (the quotes stay), a quoted key, extra spaces, a comment and blank lines at the end of the file, and the word `draft` or `status` inside another value are all kept exactly as written.
